name: flow
description: Connect Claude to your flow workspace to find projects, tasks, calendar events, posts, comments, notifications, and wiki documents. Create and update work items using the permissions of the account you sign in with. Batch writes are previewed before they are applied, and irreversible actions require explicit confirmation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add flow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add flow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://flow.team/ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the flow MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: flow lists 39 MCP tools, including flow_add_project_participants, flow_collect_dept_chain, flow_collect_project_chain, flow_create_column, flow_create_comment, flow_create_event, flow_create_post, flow_create_project, flow_create_schedule, flow_create_tasks, flow_create_todo, and flow_create_view.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to flow?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to flow in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
flow requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
flow is developed by Madrascheck. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
